sources.notes: Automation remains disabled. The Law Society legal conditions prohibit storing/reproducing directory data without prior written permission and prohibit using it for marketing/prospecting lists or commercial information services.

sources.name: Solicitors Regulation Authority - Firm Data Web Service
sources.notes: SRA Data Share API V1 offers free programmatic access to firm data, including authorisation status, websites and areas of law. A registered account and subscription key are required; the key must remain secret and attribution to the SRA is mandatory. Keep blocked until the operator registers, stores the key in the environment and completes adapter validation.

config.api_product: SRA Data Share API Version V1
config.status_semantics: Use SRA authorisation status field; do not infer from listing alone.
